purpose: Context KB for pain.002.001.10 Customer Payment Status Report V10 validation (CBPR+ SR2026). For each XML tag: possible errors, affected tags, and fix suggestions, plus ISO 20022 / CBPR+ formal rules.

iso_20022_rules.R1_OrgnlGroupInformation: OrgnlGrpInfAndSts is mandatory and must reference the original message via OrgnlMsgId and OrgnlMsgNmId.
iso_20022_rules.R2_StatusReasonOnReject: If a transaction or group status is RJCT, the corresponding StsRsnInf (status reason) should be present to explain the rejection.
iso_20022_rules.R3_ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus: GrpSts, PmtInfSts and TxSts values must be valid ExternalPaymentGroupStatus / ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus codes.
iso_20022_rules.R4_OriginalIdentification: OrgnlInstrId, OrgnlEndToEndId, OrgnlTxId and OrgnlUETR must be copied unchanged from the original (reported) message.
iso_20022_rules.R5_StatusReasonCode: StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd must be a valid ExternalStatusReason1Code (e.g. AC01, AM04, MS03) or NARR when free-text is supplied in AddtlInf.
iso_20022_rules.R6_PartialAcceptance: GrpSts = PART (partially accepted) requires per-transaction TxSts to be populated so accepted and rejected items are distinguishable.
iso_20022_rules.R7_OriginalMessageNameIdentifier: OrgnlMsgNmId identifies the reported message type (e.g. pain.001.001.09) and must be a valid ISO 20022 message identifier.
iso_20022_rules.XSD_BICFIPattern: BICFIDec2014Identifier: [A-Z0-9]{4}[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})? — applies to AppHdr/Fr, AppHdr/To and all FinInstnId/BICFI in the status report.
iso_20022_rules.XSD_AmountConstraints: ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount (used in ChrgsInf/Amt in TxInfAndSts): fractionDigits=5, totalDigits=18, minInclusive=0. Ccy attribute required.
iso_20022_rules.XSD_StatusCodeNARR_AddtlInf: ISO 20022 base rule (R16 in pacs.002): If StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd = NARR, then AddtlInf MUST be present in the same StsRsnInf block.
iso_20022_rules.XSD_V14Changes_pain002: pain.002.001.14 (latest XSD) vs 001.10: TxInfAndSts/ChrgsInf removed (was optional in 001.10, removed in 001.14). TxInfAndSts/AccptncDtTm removed. TxInfAndSts/AcctSvcrRef removed. OrgnlTxRef added at TxInfAndSts level with full original transaction details.
iso_20022_rules.DuplicateIdentifierValue: [DUPLICATE_ID_VALUE] Identifiers required to be unique within a message (e.g. InstrId, TxId, EndToEndId, UETR) must not repeat across transactions or collide with GrpHdr/MsgId.
iso_20022_rules.BicNotInDirectory: [BIC_NOT_FOUND] Each BICFI should resolve to a registered institution in the official BIC directory.
iso_20022_rules.MissingLeiAdvisory: [MISSING_LEI_ADVISORY] Under SR2026 a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is highly recommended for all financial institutions.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules: AppHdr (BusinessApplicationHeaderV02) is mandatory for all CBPR+ messages and must precede the Document element.
AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.02' for the status report exchange under CBPR+ SR2025.
AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'pain.002.001.10' and match the Document namespace.
AppHdr/BizMsgIdr must equal Document/CstmrPmtStsRpt/GrpHdr/MsgId.
AppHdr/CreDt and all ISODateTime fields must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; the 'Z' suffix and milliseconds are forbidden.
AppHdr/Fr and AppHdr/To must carry valid BIC8 or BIC11 (ISO 9362) identifiers when exchanged on the SWIFT network.
GrpSts, PmtInfSts and TxSts must use codes from the ExternalPaymentGroupStatus / ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus lists.
If TxSts = RJCT (or PmtInfSts = RJCT / GrpSts = RJCT) then at least one StsRsnInf with Rsn/Cd must be present.
OrgnlUETR, when present, must be a valid lowercase UUID v4 and must match the UETR of the original transaction.
All proprietary/text fields are limited to the FIN-X character set; accented characters must be transliterated to ASCII.
StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd must be a valid ExternalStatusReason1Code; use NARR with AddtlInf when no specific code applies.
The Business Message Identifier must match the Message Identification in the Group Header.
If used, the Related BAH must transport the exact same information as in the BAH of the related message.

The Business Message Identifier is the unique identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header, as defined by the sending application or system. Must contain the Message Identification element from the Group Header of the underlying message, where available (as is typically the case with pacs, pain, and camt messages, for example). If Message Identification is not available in the underlying message, then this element must contain the unique identifier of the Business Message instance.

The Message Definition Identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header. In general, it must be formatted exactly as it appears in the namespace of the Business Message instance.
If related BAH is present, it should transport the element Business Service.
The Original Payment Information Identification must be the same as the Original Message Identification in the Original Group Information And Status.
Forwarding Agent should respect the Message ID provided by the Initiating Party of the pain.001 and pain.002.
Original Message Identification must transport the Message Identification of the underlying payment (e.g. pain.001).
This element must be populated with either pain.001.001.xx, or pain.008.001.xx.
If TransactionStatus/Code equals RJCT, then “Status Reason Information/Reason” is mandatory.
If provided in the original pain.001, this Id is returned.
Must transport the EndToEnd Identification of the underlying pain.001.
If provided in the original pain.001, this value is returned.
If any BIC is absent, then Name is mandatory.
If Postal Address is present, then Name is mandatory.
If AnyBIC is present, in addition to any other optional elements, in case of conflicting information it will always take precedence.
Data present in structured elements within the Postal Address must not, under any circumstances be repeated in AddressLine.
Additional Information may only be used when Reason Code contains the code NARR.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Insert a StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd under OrgnlGrpInfAndSts when GrpSts = RJCT.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If PmtInfSts = RJCT then a StsRsnInf with Rsn/Cd should be present at PaymentInformation level
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Insert a StsRsnInf block under OrgnlPmtInfAndSts when PmtInfSts = RJCT.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpSts / PmtInfSts / TxSts must all be valid ExternalPaymentGroupStatus / ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus codes
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Replace any out-of-list status with a valid code (ACCP, ACSC, ACSP, ACWC, ACWP, PART, PDNG, RJCT, RCVD).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: OrgnlMsgNmId identifies the reported message type and must be a valid ISO 20022 message identifier (e.g. pain.001.001.09)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set OrgnlMsgNmId to the identifier of the original reported message.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If GrpSts = PART (partial acceptance) then per-transaction TxSts must be populated so accepted and rejected items are distinguishable
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Populate TxSts on each TxInfAndSts when GrpSts/PmtInfSts = PART.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: OrgnlInstrId / OrgnlEndToEndId / OrgnlTxId / OrgnlUETR must be copied unchanged from the original (reported) transaction
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest each original identifier from the reported message; do not regenerate.

schema_mapping_notes.root_element: Document/CstmrPmtStsRpt is the root; the message type is CustomerPaymentStatusReportV10.
schema_mapping_notes.msg_def_idr: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr = pain.002.001.10 and must match the Document xmlns urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.002.001.10.
schema_mapping_notes.biz_svc: AppHdr/BizSvc = swift.cbprplus.02 for the CBPR+ status report exchange under SR2025.
schema_mapping_notes.original_group: OrgnlGrpInfAndSts references the reported message via OrgnlMsgId (original GrpHdr/MsgId) and OrgnlMsgNmId (original message identifier, e.g. pain.001.001.09).
schema_mapping_notes.status_codelists: GrpSts/PmtInfSts use ExternalPaymentGroupStatus; TxSts uses ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus; StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd uses ExternalStatusReason1Code.
schema_mapping_notes.datetime_format: All ISODateTime fields (AppHdr/CreDt, GrpHdr/CreDtTm, OrgnlCreDtTm) use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; Z suffix and milliseconds are forbidden under CBPR+.
schema_mapping_notes.reject_reason_dependency: A RJCT status at group, payment-information or transaction level requires a corresponding StsRsnInf with Rsn/Cd.
